ruling.recommended_action: Refund $8.06 to the rider's original payment method (excess distance fare for the Jalan Anak Bukit / Dunearn Road / Rifle Range Road segment only) and issue the driver a notification-duty reminder logged on his route compliance record (RD-7); no formal warning — first notification-related incident.
ruling.reasoning:
Route deviation (RD-1): actual 30.9 km vs optimal 20.6 km [F1] = +10.3 km, well over the 1 km tolerance. Two off-route segments [F3][F4] account for 5.71 + 4.73 = 10.44 km of the 10.31 km deviation (map-matching noise).

Traffic screen (RD-4): no incidents recorded [F14]; the only speed-band data available are on BKT [F12] and PIE [F13] at band 8 (70+ km/h, free-flow) — these are not the replaced parts of the recommended route and show no congestion, so neither segment has a traffic reason.

Segment 22:54–23:03 [F3]: before it began, at 22:50 the driver asked “Jam ahead, can go via Upper Bukit Timah Road?” [F8] and the rider replied “ok” at 22:51 [F9] — consent given before the segment. The roads driven include UPPER BUKIT TIMAH ROAD, so the named road was in fact driven; under RD-5 the connecting roads onto and off it (Dairy Farm Road, Jalan Anak Bukit, Dunearn Road, Rifle Range Road) are part of going via it, and “ok” is unqualified, not an “ok, but not via Y”. That segment is therefore the rider's own route → exempt → RD-2/RD-3, no refund for its distance.

Segment 23:07–23:13 [F4]: driven entirely on roads the rider never named (Arcadia Road, Adam Road, Lornie Highway, Lornie Road, Kheam Hock Road, Trevose Crescent, Merryn Road); the driver's post-trip statement “She agreed to my route” [F11] is a claim made after the fact, not consent at or before the start of this segment, and the chat record contains no message covering it [F10]. No traffic justification. So 4.73 km counts as an unagreed deviation.

Amount (RD-2): the rider wants the whole excess refunded, but only non-exempt km are refundable. 4.73 km × $1.41/km (this trip's distance fare per km, 30.88 km for $43.54 [F5][F7]) = $6.67 (recomputed from the fare table; the stated $14.54 excess covers all 10.31 km). Tolls, time fare and surge are not refunded. Confidence: solid on the arithmetic and on the second segment; reduced only by the interpretive latitude in treating the unqualified “ok” as covering the whole road sequence driven.

Precedent: DISP-2026-0089 (uninformed reroute, partial refund of excess distance fare) aligns. No repeat-deviation flag: the driver's one upheld dispute is a no-show, not a route deviation (route: 0) [F17], so RD-6 does not apply. TH-1: amount under $10 → system ruling final. RD-7 notification-duty reminder to be logged.

segment_findings.reason: Driver asked at 22:50 to go via Upper Bukit Timah Road [F8]; rider answered “ok” at 22:51 [F9], before the segment began. Upper Bukit Timah Road was in fact driven, and the connecting roads onto/off it (Dairy Farm Rd → Jalan Anak Bukit → Dunearn Rd → Rifle Range Rd) are part of going via it. RD-5/RD-3: rider's own route, not a deviation.

This segment, at 23:07–23:13, drove Arcadia Rd → Adam Rd → Lornie Highway → Lornie Rd → Kheam Hock Rd → Trevose Cres → Merryn Rd, none of which the rider named; the only consent in the record (22:51 “ok” [F9]) covers the earlier Upper Bukit Timah Road route, not this one. The driver's post-trip “She agreed to my route” [F11] is a claim, not consent at or before the segment. No traffic reason (RD-4 fails: F14, free-flow bands only on BKT/PIE [F12][F13]). 4.73 km counts under RD-2.

element_findings.reason: No incident, closure or congestion event near the recommended route during the trip window [F14]; the only traffic readings are free-flow (band 8, 70+ km/h) on BKT and PIE [F12][F13], which are not the replaced parts of the route. Neither off-route segment qualifies.

element_findings.element: Rider consent to the named road for segment 22:54–23:03 (RD-5/RD-3)
element_findings.reason: Driver's question naming Upper Bukit Timah Road at 22:50 [F8] was accepted pre-segment at 22:51 with an unqualified “ok” [F9]; the named road appears among the roads driven on that segment [F3].

The only rider message in the timestamped record is the 22:51 “ok” [F9][F10], which answers the Upper Bukit Timah Road proposal; nothing in the chat covers the later Lornie/Merryn routing [F4], and the driver's written statement [F11] cannot supply pre-segment consent.

element_findings.element: Why the driver took the off-route segments (RD-0/NS-0 not applicable; RD-2 branch)
element_findings.reason: The record shows a route choice with no traffic justification (driver cited “jam ahead” [F8] but no incident or congestion exists [F14]) — the RD-2 “no traffic reason” branch: refund excess distance fare and record a driver violation.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider asks for the whole excess distance ($14.54) back, but 5.71 km of the deviation was on the route the rider agreed to before it began [F8][F9][F3]; only the 4.73 km of the unagreed Lornie/Merryn segment is refundable under RD-2/RD-5.

The driver's statement “She agreed to my route” [F11] was written after the trip and is not reflected in the timestamped chat [F10]; a driver's claim of verbal agreement is not consent, and no call recording exists (RD-5).
